root_cause: The page/browser control already evaluated the canonical production-projected site, while the SEO strategy checker evaluated raw repository HTML. This produced shell false positives and allowed current source wording/metadata findings to persist independently.
prevention_rule: Public SEO strategy checks must execute against the same production-projected site tree as page/browser checks. Source auto-fixes may not reintroduce metadata that violates the checker. Known blocked brand language and title/meta limits stay covered by regression.
